conclusion: unknown (Ask) specifies 4 of 5 categories: 8 autonomy limits, 5 clarification rules, 7 validation rules, 1 escalation rule; none for approval gates. Strongest: autonomy limits.

autonomy_limits.conclusion: 8 autonomy limits (8 mandatory, 0 advisory; 3 conditional), mostly prose: the canonical R2 storage target; installing new tooling mid-ingest; uploading or writing before inspection.

statements.quote: Use Cloudflare R2 as the canonical upload target unless the user explicitly changes the storage decision.
Do not install random new tooling in the middle of ingestion just to get around a local environment issue.
Start read-only.
Do not upload or rewrite content before this summary exists.
If the answers are obvious enough, proceed and state the assumptions.
If the machine still has an `npx`/Node mismatch, use the already-working local Wrangler path rather than installing random new tooling mid-ingest.
do not hand-author a normal album page under `pages/photography/`
Do not upload first and figure out meaning later.

clarification_rules.conclusion: 5 clarification rules (4 mandatory, 1 advisory; 5 conditional), mostly prose: questions only when they affect storage or metadata; inventing missing or low-confidence metadata; ambiguous folder shapes.

statements.quote: Only ask when the answer materially affects storage keys, page placement, or authored metadata.
if date information is missing, it is acceptable to ship a date-less title and slug rather than inventing one
AI should not silently invent critical metadata when confidence is low.
If confidence is low on something user-facing, surface the uncertainty.
Escalate when:

validation.conclusion: 7 validation rules (7 mandatory, 0 advisory; 2 conditional), mostly prose: definition of done for a photography run; verifying public delivery URLs; site build and page checks after updates.

statements.quote: For a normal photography run, “done” means all of the following are true:
Do not treat “JSON was written” as success if the upload path or delivery verification is still broken.
only proceed to repo writes after the upload path is proven to work
After upload, verify the public URLs.
Do not write final canonical URLs into the repo until delivery verification passes or the failure is explicitly acknowledged.
confirm the affected page renders correctly
check for broken references introduced by the ingestion

escalation.conclusion: 1 escalation rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly prose: failed upload verification.

statements.quote: If upload verification fails, stop before writing final canonical URLs unless the user explicitly asks for a partial or placeholder repo update.
